def test_plan_total_matches_summary_on_noisy_track(make_track):
    from trailhead.report import summarise

    track = make_track(*[(0, i * 0.001, 1000 + (i % 2) * 2) for i in range(40)])
    total = sum(day[3] for day in split_days(track, max_hours_per_day=100))
